title: Students' Abnormal Behavior in Online Exam Dataset
creator: Muhanad Alkhalisy
known_limitations: The archive contains 5,575 images, which differs from the associated paper's reported image counts; the paper also contains conflicting annotation-format descriptions.
The dataset describes observable behaviors and does not establish misconduct or intent.
The paper describes participants from one university; representativeness is limited.
Participant/session IDs are not included in the archive. Filename-derived source groups are provisional and do not establish person-independent splits.
The supplied train/valid splits share all 38 filename-derived source groups; the supplied test split has no labels and contains five exact duplicate images from train/valid.
One zero-width box is invalid. The data.yaml paths do not resolve to the archive's split directories.
The paper discusses consent/privacy but does not provide clear consent/ethics approval evidence for these images. The CC BY 4.0 record license does not establish participant consent.
